registration.scope: One saved ten-match dataset: all five official fields, both placements, fixed inputs/seeds, reuse zero. Export and full local graph validation in separate fresh child processes. No R2, Pages, full 7600 execution or 300s claim.

registrationEncoding.description: Only report presentation changes: registration.partitions[].batch.slots[].key is stored as slotIdentityDigest with an explicit sha256: prefix. Restore the original key by removing that prefix and ordering slot fields by slotFieldOrder; compact JSON.stringify reproduces originalSha256 (asserted during report creation). Inputs and measured execution are unchanged. This prevents generic API-key scanners mistaking deterministic public slot hashes for credentials. No scanner rule or exception is changed.

definition: Same ten freshly produced saved matches; compare existing v1 export with opt-in v2 pack export on the same source. Simulation is performed once during preparation and excluded from export timing. Every trial starts a fresh Node process and empty output directory; one warmup and five alternating pairs. Full existing semantic/privacy validation: 20 calls during export, 10 during subsequent audit. No result/record expectations regenerated.

runner.contents:
import json, pathlib, subprocess, time, os

root = pathlib.Path('.generated/pack-pilot')
order = [('warmup', 0, f) for f in ['v1','v2']]
for pair in range(1,6):
    for fmt in (['v1','v2'] if pair % 2 else ['v2','v1']):
        order.append(('measured',pair,fmt))
receipts=[]
for number,(kind,pair,fmt) in enumerate(order):
    name=f'{number:02d}-{kind}-{pair}-{fmt}'
    output=root/f'{name}.json'
    command=['node','--import','./apps/api/node_modules/tsx/dist/loader.mjs','.generated/pack-pilot.mjs','trial',str(root),str(output),fmt]
    started=time.time()
    receipt={'kind':kind,'pair':pair,'format':fmt,'output':str(output),'command':command,'startedAt':started,'timeoutSeconds':180}
    with (root/f'{name}.log').open('wb') as log:
        try:
            done=subprocess.run(command,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=180,check=False)
            receipt['exitCode']=done.returncode
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            receipt['exitCode']=124
            receipt['timedOut']=True
    receipt['processWallMs']=(time.time()-started)*1000
    receipts.append(receipt)
    (root/'process-receipts.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipts,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(receipt),flush=True)
    if receipt['exitCode']!=0:
        raise SystemExit(receipt['exitCode'])

reproduction.notes: Extract embedded sources to their paths. Use a fresh output directory. Raw trial records reconstruct by replacing files/canonicalResults references with dictionaries, preserving property order; JSON.stringify(value,null,2)+newline reproduces the recorded digest and byte count.

interpretation.conclusion: Object count and fsync reduction are demonstrated for this fixed 10-match data. Small wall-time differences do not prove full-league speedup. Pack indexes add metadata bytes; original compressed recording and JSON bytes remain exact.
limits: Not a 7600-match run or 270/300-second acceptance; do not extrapolate 1000-object compliance to full league.
No R2/Reader/Pages transport, Cloudflare CPU/memory or billed Class A/B request measurement; production deployment remains separate.

Local export includes full validations and durable writes; post-export audit is reported separately. Process wall additionally includes loader/startup/record writing. No cold-cache or hosted-runner claim.
Private producer remains a durable individual-bundle spool; this measures public export only. Producer fsync reduction, streaming artifact transfer and incremental finalization remain later work.
save.read ENOENT, directory.lstat ENOENT and mkdir EEXIST are expected absent/existing-path probes and retained in measurements; operation trials and all replay validations succeeded.
No pruning, budget increases, production keys or real publication used.
Recorded process CPU includes all Worker CPU; inclusive spans are not added to wall or process CPU.
